data_quality.sql:
-- Step 1: data quality checks. Every check states what it expects; the analysis below is only trusted if all pass.

WITH checks AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n, 'Orders loaded' AS check_name,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM orders) AS found, 'more than 0' AS expected,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM orders) > 0 AS passed
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Duplicate order ids',
           (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Dealer order number used twice by one dealer (non-rejected orders)',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT dealer_code, dealer_order_no FROM orders WHERE current_status <> 'REJECTED'
                                  GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*) > 1)), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Order lines without an order',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM order_lines l ANTI JOIN orders o USING (order_id)), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 5, 'Orders whose line count does not match their lines',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM orders o
             WHERE o.line_count <> (SELECT count(*) FROM order_lines l WHERE l.order_id = o.order_id)), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 6, 'Orders whose net amount differs from the sum of their lines',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM orders o
             WHERE o.net_amount <> (SELECT sum(line_net) FROM order_lines l WHERE l.order_id = o.order_id)), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 7, 'Orders whose gross amount is not net plus VAT',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE gross_amount <> net_amount + vat_amount), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 8, 'Orders without RECEIVED as the first status',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM orders o
             WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_status_history h
                                WHERE h.order_id = o.order_id AND h.sequence = 1 AND h.status = 'RECEIVED')), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 9, 'Orders with gaps in the status sequence',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_status_history GROUP BY order_id
                                  HAVING max(sequence) <> count(*))), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 10, 'Status changes earlier than the previous one',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT occurred_at < lag(occurred_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY sequence) AS back
                                  FROM order_status_history) WHERE back), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 11, 'Current status differs from the last history entry',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM orders o
              JOIN (SELECT order_id, arg_max(status, sequence) AS last_status FROM order_status_history GROUP BY order_id) h
             USING (order_id) WHERE o.current_status <> h.last_status), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 12, 'Shipments for orders that were never allocated',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM shipments s
             WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_status_history h WHERE h.order_id = s.order_id AND h.status = 'ALLOCATED')),
           '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 13, 'Invoices without a confirmed shipment',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN shipments s USING (order_id) WHERE s.confirmed_at IS NULL), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 14, 'Orders with more than one invoice (RULE-13: one per shipment)',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM invoices GROUP BY order_id HAVING count(*) > 1)), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 15, 'Invoice amounts that differ from the order',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices i JOIN orders o USING (order_id) WHERE i.gross_amount <> o.gross_amount), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 16, 'Invoices delivered before they were accepted by the integrator',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE delivered_at < accepted_at), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 17, 'Acknowledgements for invoices that were not delivered',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM acknowledgements a JOIN invoices i USING (ettn) WHERE i.delivered_at IS NULL), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 18, 'Webhook events with more than 6 attempts (RULE-16)',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT event_id FROM webhook_deliveries GROUP BY event_id HAVING max(attempt) > 6)), '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 19, 'Accepted submissions without an order',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM order_submissions s
             WHERE s.result_code IN ('ACCEPTED', 'REPLAYED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.order_id = s.order_id)),
           '0', NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 20, 'Orders from suspended dealers after the suspension date',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM orders o JOIN dealers d USING (dealer_code)
             WHERE d.suspended_from IS NOT NULL AND CAST(o.received_at AS DATE) >= d.suspended_from), '0', NULL
)
SELECT n, check_name, found, expected, coalesce(passed, found = 0) AS passed
FROM checks
ORDER BY n;

daily_exception_report.sql:
-- Step 2: the daily exception report (UC-09, BRD section 7.6), as run on Monday 5 July 2027 at 07:00.
-- Five groups of items that would otherwise stall silently. Each line names the order, invoice or dealer to act on.
-- issue_code, document_no and quantity let the report site build the text in Turkish or English.
-- Group 1 reads "without an invoice" as "no invoice accepted by the integrator", so held and failed invoices are included.

WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM report_params),
report_day AS (
    SELECT c.working_day_index AS idx FROM calendar c, p WHERE c.day = p.report_date
),
previous_working_day AS (
    SELECT max(c.day) AS day FROM calendar c, p WHERE c.is_working_day AND c.day < p.report_date
),
-- 1. Shipped more than one working day ago, no invoice accepted by the integrator
g1 AS (
    SELECT '1 Shipped, invoice not sent'                          AS exception_group,
           s.order_id                                             AS reference,
           o.dealer_code,
           CASE WHEN i.ettn IS NULL               THEN 'NO_INVOICE'
                WHEN i.final_state = 'HELD'        THEN 'HELD'
                WHEN i.final_state = 'SEND_FAILED' THEN 'SEND_FAILED'
                ELSE 'NOT_SENT' END                               AS issue_code,
           o.dealer_order_no                                      AS document_no,
           NULL::INTEGER                                          AS quantity,
           CASE WHEN i.ettn IS NULL               THEN 'No invoice created in the ERP'
                WHEN i.final_state = 'HELD'        THEN 'Invoice held: dealer tax number not on the GİB list'
                WHEN i.final_state = 'SEND_FAILED' THEN 'Invoice rejected by the integrator, not yet resent'
                ELSE 'Invoice created, not yet sent' END          AS detail,
           s.confirmed_at                                         AS since
    FROM shipments s
    JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
    LEFT JOIN invoices i USING (order_id)
    JOIN calendar c ON c.day = CAST(s.confirmed_at AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN report_day r
    WHERE s.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
      AND i.accepted_at IS NULL
      AND r.idx - c.working_day_index > 1
),
-- 2. Sent to the integrator more than 24 hours ago, not delivered
g2 AS (
    SELECT '2 Sent, not delivered within 24 hours',
           i.ettn,
           i.dealer_code,
           'AT_INTEGRATOR',
           i.invoice_no,
           NULL::INTEGER,
           'Invoice ' || i.invoice_no || ' still ' || i.final_state || ' at Köprü e-Belge',
           i.accepted_at
    FROM invoices i, p
    WHERE i.accepted_at IS NOT NULL
      AND i.delivered_at IS NULL
      AND i.accepted_at < p.as_of - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
),
-- 3. Delivered, not acknowledged within 5 working days, by dealers whose connector acknowledges invoices
g3 AS (
    SELECT '3 Delivered, not acknowledged in 5 working days',
           i.ettn,
           i.dealer_code,
           'NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED',
           i.invoice_no,
           NULL::INTEGER,
           'Invoice ' || i.invoice_no || ' for dealer order ' || o.dealer_order_no,
           i.delivered_at
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
    JOIN dealers d ON d.dealer_code = i.dealer_code
    LEFT JOIN acknowledgements a USING (ettn)
    JOIN calendar c ON c.day = CAST(i.delivered_at AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN report_day r
    WHERE i.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
      AND a.ettn IS NULL
      AND d.acknowledges_invoices
      AND o.channel = 'API'
      AND o.current_status <> 'CLOSED'           -- orders close automatically 30 days after INVOICED
      AND r.idx - c.working_day_index > 5
),
-- 4. Dealers whose webhook endpoint fails: events exhausted in the last 7 days and the latest attempt still failing
last_attempt AS (
    SELECT dealer_code, arg_max(result, attempted_at) AS last_result
    FROM webhook_deliveries GROUP BY dealer_code
),
exhausted AS (
    SELECT w.dealer_code, count(*) AS events, min(w.attempted_at) AS first_exhausted_at
    FROM webhook_deliveries w, p
    WHERE w.result = 'EXHAUSTED' AND w.attempted_at >= p.as_of - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    GROUP BY w.dealer_code
),
g4 AS (
    SELECT '4 Webhook endpoint failing',
           e.dealer_code,
           e.dealer_code,
           'WEBHOOK_FAILING',
           NULL,
           e.events::INTEGER,
           e.events || ' events failed all 6 attempts; latest attempt ' || l.last_result,
           e.first_exhausted_at
    FROM exhausted e JOIN last_attempt l USING (dealer_code)
    WHERE l.last_result <> 'DELIVERED'
),
-- 5. Shipment confirmation late or missing: confirmed yesterday more than 24 hours after pickup, or not confirmed at all
g5 AS (
    SELECT '5 Shipment confirmation late or missing',
           s.order_id,
           o.dealer_code,
           CASE WHEN s.confirmed_at IS NULL THEN 'NOT_CONFIRMED' ELSE 'LATE_CONFIRMATION' END,
           o.dealer_order_no,
           CASE WHEN s.confirmed_at IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE date_diff('hour', s.carrier_pickup_at, s.confirmed_at)::INTEGER END,
           CASE WHEN s.confirmed_at IS NULL THEN 'Picked up by the carrier, not confirmed in the ERP'
                ELSE 'Confirmed ' || round(date_diff('minute', s.carrier_pickup_at, s.confirmed_at) / 60.0, 1)
                     || ' hours after carrier pickup' END,
           s.carrier_pickup_at
    FROM shipments s
    JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
    CROSS JOIN p
    CROSS JOIN previous_working_day y
    WHERE (s.confirmed_at IS NULL AND s.carrier_pickup_at < p.as_of - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
       OR (CAST(s.confirmed_at AS DATE) = y.day AND s.confirmed_at - s.carrier_pickup_at > INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
),
all_groups AS (
    SELECT * FROM g1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM g2 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM g3
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM g4 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM g5
)
SELECT a.exception_group, a.reference, a.dealer_code, a.detail,
       a.since, date_diff('hour', a.since, p.as_of) AS age_hours,
       a.issue_code, a.document_no, a.quantity          -- structured fields for the report site
FROM all_groups a, p
ORDER BY a.exception_group, a.since;

kpi_channel_adoption.sql:
-- Step 3: G1, remove manual order entry. Share of order lines received through the API or the dealer portal, per week.
-- Target: at least 80% of order lines, six months after go-live (BRD section 4).

SELECT c.period_week                                                       AS week,
       p.period_start + 7 * (c.period_week - 1)                            AS week_start,
       sum(o.line_count)                                                   AS order_lines,
       sum(o.line_count) FILTER (WHERE o.channel = 'API')                  AS api_lines,
       sum(o.line_count) FILTER (WHERE o.channel = 'PORTAL')               AS portal_lines,
       sum(o.line_count) FILTER (WHERE o.channel = 'MANUAL')               AS manual_lines,
       round(100.0 * sum(o.line_count) FILTER (WHERE o.channel <> 'MANUAL') / sum(o.line_count), 1)
                                                                           AS integrated_share_pct,
       count(DISTINCT o.dealer_code) FILTER (WHERE o.channel <> 'MANUAL')  AS dealers_ordering_integrated,
       80                                                                  AS target_pct
FROM orders o
JOIN calendar c ON c.day = CAST(o.received_at AS DATE)
CROSS JOIN report_params p
GROUP BY c.period_week, p.period_start
ORDER BY week;

kpi_order_corrections.sql:
-- Step 4: G2, reduce order errors. Orders corrected in the ERP after entry, per week and channel.
-- Baseline 4% of orders, target below 0.5%. Integrated orders are validated at the source; manual ones are keyed by hand.

SELECT c.period_week                                                                  AS week,
       count(*)                                                                       AS orders,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.corrected_after_entry)                                AS corrected,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.corrected_after_entry) / count(*), 2)   AS corrected_pct,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.corrected_after_entry AND o.channel <> 'MANUAL')
             / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.channel <> 'MANUAL'), 0), 2)           AS corrected_pct_integrated,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.corrected_after_entry AND o.channel = 'MANUAL')
             / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.channel = 'MANUAL'), 0), 2)            AS corrected_pct_manual,
       0.5                                                                            AS target_pct
FROM orders o
JOIN calendar c ON c.day = CAST(o.received_at AS DATE)
GROUP BY c.period_week
ORDER BY week;

kpi_decision_time.sql:
-- Step 5: G3, faster acknowledgement. Time from RECEIVED to the first decision, and approval tasks against their
-- due time of 4 business hours (RULE-08). Targets: under 2 minutes for automatic decisions, approvals within due.

WITH first_decision AS (
    SELECT d.order_id, r.occurred_at AS received_at, d.occurred_at AS decided_at, d.status,
           date_diff('millisecond', r.occurred_at, d.occurred_at) / 1000.0 AS seconds
    FROM order_status_history d
    JOIN order_status_history r ON r.order_id = d.order_id AND r.sequence = 1
    WHERE d.sequence = 2
),
erp_incident AS (
    SELECT started_at, ended_at FROM incidents WHERE system = 'ERP'
),
tasks AS (
    SELECT *, decided_at <= due_at AS on_time FROM approval_tasks WHERE decided_at IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 1 AS n, 'Orders with a first decision' AS metric, count(*)::DOUBLE AS value, 'orders' AS unit, '' AS target
FROM first_decision
UNION ALL
SELECT 2, 'Median time to the first decision', round(median(seconds), 1), 'seconds', '' FROM first_decision
UNION ALL
SELECT 3, '95th percentile time to the first decision', round(quantile_cont(seconds, 0.95), 1), 'seconds',
       'under 60 (NFR-PERF-04)' FROM first_decision
UNION ALL
SELECT 4, 'First decision within 2 minutes', round(100.0 * avg((seconds <= 120)::INTEGER), 2), '% of orders',
       '100 (G3)' FROM first_decision
UNION ALL
SELECT 5, 'Orders received during the ERP incident', count(*), 'orders', ''
FROM first_decision f, erp_incident e WHERE f.received_at >= e.started_at AND f.received_at < e.ended_at
UNION ALL
SELECT 6, 'Longest wait for a decision during the ERP incident', round(max(f.seconds) / 60, 1), 'minutes', ''
FROM first_decision f, erp_incident e WHERE f.received_at >= e.started_at AND f.received_at < e.ended_at
UNION ALL
SELECT 7, 'Orders sent to approval', count(*), 'orders', '' FROM approval_tasks
UNION ALL
SELECT 8, 'Approval tasks decided within 4 business hours', round(100.0 * avg(on_time::INTEGER), 1), '% of tasks',
       '100 (RULE-08)' FROM tasks
UNION ALL
SELECT 9, 'Approval tasks escalated to the sales manager', count(*) FILTER (WHERE escalated_at IS NOT NULL), 'tasks', ''
FROM approval_tasks
UNION ALL
SELECT 10, 'Median clock time to an approval decision', round(median(date_diff('minute', created_at, decided_at)) / 60.0, 1),
       'hours', '' FROM tasks
UNION ALL
SELECT 11, 'Approvals on time, credit limit cases', round(100.0 * avg(on_time::INTEGER) FILTER (WHERE reason_code = 'CREDIT_LIMIT'), 1),
       '% of tasks', '' FROM tasks
UNION ALL
SELECT 12, 'Approvals on time, partial stock cases', round(100.0 * avg(on_time::INTEGER) FILTER (WHERE reason_code = 'PARTIAL_STOCK'), 1),
       '% of tasks', '' FROM tasks
ORDER BY n;

kpi_stock_self_service.sql:
-- Step 6: G4, self-service stock. Stock questions by phone (sales support tally) against stock queries through
-- the API and the portal, per working day. Baseline about 60 phone questions a day, target below 6.

SELECT s.week_start,
       s.working_days,
       round(s.phone_stock_questions / s.working_days, 1)  AS phone_stock_questions_per_day,
       round(sum(t.requests) / s.working_days)             AS stock_queries_per_day,
       round(s.order_status_calls / s.working_days, 1)     AS order_status_calls_per_day,
       6                                                   AS target_phone_per_day
FROM support_tally_weekly s
JOIN api_daily_traffic t
  ON t.endpoint = 'GET /stock' AND t.day >= s.week_start AND t.day < s.week_start + 7
GROUP BY s.week_start, s.working_days, s.phone_stock_questions, s.order_status_calls
ORDER BY s.week_start;

kpi_invoice_cycle.sql:
-- Step 7: G5, faster invoice matching. From shipment confirmation to the e-Invoice in the dealer's GİB inbox, and from
-- delivery to the invoice.issued webhook. Baseline 1.5 working days; target same day, notification within 1 hour.

WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT i.order_id, i.delivered_at, s.confirmed_at, c.period_week,
           date_diff('minute', s.confirmed_at, i.delivered_at) / 60.0    AS hours_to_inbox,
           CAST(i.delivered_at AS DATE) = CAST(s.confirmed_at AS DATE)    AS same_day
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN shipments s USING (order_id)
    JOIN calendar c ON c.day = CAST(s.confirmed_at AS DATE)
    WHERE i.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
),
webhook AS (
    SELECT order_id, min(attempted_at) FILTER (WHERE result = 'DELIVERED') AS notified_at
    FROM webhook_deliveries
    WHERE event_type = 'invoice.issued'
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT d.period_week                                                   AS week,
       count(*)                                                        AS invoices_delivered,
       round(100.0 * avg(d.same_day::INTEGER), 1)                      AS same_day_pct,
       round(median(d.hours_to_inbox), 2)                              AS median_hours,
       round(quantile_cont(d.hours_to_inbox, 0.95), 2)                 AS p95_hours,
       count(w.order_id)                                               AS webhook_notifications,
       round(100.0 * avg((w.notified_at <= d.delivered_at + INTERVAL 1 HOUR)::INTEGER)
             FILTER (WHERE w.order_id IS NOT NULL), 1)                 AS notified_within_1h_pct
FROM delivered d
LEFT JOIN webhook w USING (order_id)
GROUP BY d.period_week
ORDER BY week;

kpi_reconciliation.sql:
-- Step 8: G6, fewer reconciliation issues. Invoices the dealer's ERP booked with a different total, per month.
-- Baseline about 45 mismatches a month with PDF invoices; target below 5. July covers only the first days.

SELECT strftime(i.delivered_at, '%Y-%m')                                   AS month,
       count(*)                                                            AS invoices_delivered,
       count(a.ettn)                                                       AS acknowledged,
       count(a.ettn) FILTER (WHERE a.match_result = 'MISMATCH')            AS mismatches,
       sum(abs(a.dealer_booked_gross - i.gross_amount))
           FILTER (WHERE a.match_result = 'MISMATCH')                      AS mismatch_amount_try,
       5                                                                   AS target_max_per_month
FROM invoices i
LEFT JOIN acknowledgements a USING (ettn)
WHERE i.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

ops_webhook_delivery.sql:
-- Step 9: webhook delivery (RULE-16). Per week: events created, delivered at the first attempt, delivered after
-- retries, and events that failed all 6 attempts (first attempt plus retries at 1, 5, 15, 60 and 240 minutes).

WITH events AS (
    SELECT event_id, dealer_code,
           min(event_created_at)                AS created_at,
           max(attempt)                         AS attempts,
           bool_or(result = 'DELIVERED')        AS delivered,
           bool_or(result = 'EXHAUSTED')        AS exhausted
    FROM webhook_deliveries
    GROUP BY event_id, dealer_code
)
SELECT c.period_week                                                          AS week,
       count(*)                                                               AS events,
       round(100.0 * avg((e.delivered AND e.attempts = 1)::INTEGER), 2)       AS first_attempt_pct,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.delivered AND e.attempts > 1)                 AS delivered_after_retry,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.exhausted)                                    AS exhausted,
       string_agg(DISTINCT e.dealer_code, ', ') FILTER (WHERE e.exhausted)    AS dealers_exhausted,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT e.delivered AND NOT e.exhausted)            AS still_retrying
FROM events e
JOIN calendar c ON c.day = CAST(e.created_at AS DATE)
GROUP BY c.period_week
ORDER BY week;

ops_order_submissions.sql:
-- Step 10: order submissions by result (error scenarios, section 3). Shows which error codes dealers actually meet,
-- and how often idempotency protects against duplicates (REPLAYED: same key and body, original response returned).

SELECT channel,
       result_code,
       http_status,
       coalesce(field_error_code, '')                                              AS field_error_code,
       count(*)                                                                    AS submissions,
       round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY channel), 2)      AS share_of_channel_pct
FROM order_submissions
GROUP BY channel, result_code, http_status, coalesce(field_error_code, '')
ORDER BY channel, submissions DESC;

ops_invoice_delivery.sql:
-- Step 11: how each invoice reached the dealer (UC-06), and the legal deadline. Under VUK article 231/5 an invoice is
-- issued within 7 days of delivery; the integration alerts on day 5 (NFR-COMPL-01). Invoices are counted by their path.

WITH calls AS (
    SELECT ettn,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'TIMEOUT')                                         AS timeouts,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE operation = 'SendInvoice' AND result = 'FAULT')             AS send_faults,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE operation = 'GetInvoiceStatus' AND status_returned = 'ERROR') AS delivery_errors
    FROM integrator_calls
    GROUP BY ettn
),
classified AS (
    SELECT i.*, s.confirmed_at, s.carrier_pickup_at,
           CASE WHEN i.final_state <> 'DELIVERED'                    THEN 'Open at report time: ' || i.final_state
                WHEN i.held_at IS NOT NULL                           THEN 'Delivered after a tax number hold'
                WHEN coalesce(c.send_faults, 0) > 0                  THEN 'Delivered after a rejected send was fixed'
                WHEN coalesce(c.delivery_errors, 0) > 0              THEN 'Delivered after a delivery error and resend'
                WHEN coalesce(c.timeouts, 0) > 0                     THEN 'Delivered after the integrator incident'
                WHEN s.confirmed_at - s.carrier_pickup_at > INTERVAL 24 HOUR THEN 'Delivered after a late shipment confirmation'
                WHEN i.created_at - s.confirmed_at > INTERVAL 1 DAY  THEN 'Delivered, invoice created late in the ERP'
                WHEN i.delivered_at - i.accepted_at > INTERVAL 24 HOUR THEN 'Delivered, more than 24 hours at the integrator'
                ELSE 'Delivered first time' END                        AS outcome,
           date_diff('day', CAST(s.carrier_pickup_at AS DATE),       -- the goods left with the carrier
                     CAST(coalesce(i.delivered_at, p.as_of) AS DATE))   AS days_from_shipment
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN shipments s USING (order_id)
    LEFT JOIN calls c USING (ettn)
    CROSS JOIN report_params p
)
SELECT outcome,
       count(*)                                                     AS invoices,
       round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 2)           AS share_pct,
       round(median(date_diff('minute', confirmed_at, delivered_at)) / 60.0, 2) AS median_hours_to_inbox,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE days_from_shipment >= 5)              AS reached_day5_alert,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE days_from_shipment > 7)               AS beyond_7_day_limit
FROM classified
GROUP BY outcome
ORDER BY invoices DESC;

ops_incidents.sql:
-- Step 12: the two incidents of the period and their effect. NFR-REL-04 and NFR-REL-05 require that an ERP or an
-- integrator outage delays work but loses nothing: every affected order and invoice must have been processed afterwards.

WITH erp AS (
    SELECT n.incident_id,
           count(*)                                                                    AS affected,
           max(date_diff('second', r.occurred_at, d.occurred_at)) / 60.0               AS longest_delay_minutes,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.order_id IS NULL)                                  AS not_processed
    FROM incidents n
    JOIN order_status_history r ON r.sequence = 1 AND r.occurred_at >= n.started_at AND r.occurred_at < n.ended_at
    LEFT JOIN order_status_history d ON d.order_id = r.order_id AND d.sequence = 2
    WHERE n.system = 'ERP'
    GROUP BY n.incident_id
),
integrator AS (
    SELECT n.incident_id,
           count(DISTINCT c.ettn)                                                      AS affected,
           max(date_diff('second', i.created_at, i.accepted_at)) / 60.0                AS longest_delay_minutes,
           count(DISTINCT c.ettn) FILTER (WHERE i.accepted_at IS NULL)                 AS not_processed
    FROM incidents n
    JOIN integrator_calls c ON c.result = 'TIMEOUT' AND c.called_at >= n.started_at AND c.called_at < n.ended_at
    JOIN invoices i USING (ettn)
    WHERE n.system = 'INTEGRATOR'
    GROUP BY n.incident_id
),
effects AS (
    SELECT *, 'orders waiting for a first decision' AS affected_unit FROM erp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT *, 'invoices waiting to be sent' FROM integrator
)
SELECT n.incident_id, n.system, n.started_at, n.ended_at,
       date_diff('minute', n.started_at, n.ended_at)    AS duration_minutes,
       n.description,
       e.affected, e.affected_unit,
       round(e.longest_delay_minutes, 1)                AS longest_delay_minutes,
       e.not_processed
FROM incidents n
JOIN effects e USING (incident_id)
ORDER BY n.started_at;

kpi_scorecard.sql:
-- Step 13: scorecard of the six BRD goals over the last four weeks of the period (weeks 10 to 13, 7 June to 3 July).
-- status_code and value_1, value_2 are the same results as numbers, for the report site.
-- G1 has a six-month target date; the others apply from go-live. Status compares the result with the target.

WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM report_params),
recent AS (
    SELECT day FROM calendar WHERE period_week BETWEEN 10 AND 13
),
working_days AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS n FROM calendar WHERE period_week BETWEEN 10 AND 13 AND is_working_day
),
g1 AS (
    SELECT round(100.0 * sum(line_count) FILTER (WHERE channel <> 'MANUAL') / sum(line_count), 1) AS v
    FROM orders WHERE CAST(received_at AS DATE) IN (SELECT day FROM recent)
),
g2 AS (
    SELECT round(100.0 * avg(corrected_after_entry::INTEGER), 2) AS v,
           round(100.0 * avg(corrected_after_entry::INTEGER) FILTER (WHERE channel <> 'MANUAL'), 2) AS v_integrated
    FROM orders WHERE CAST(received_at AS DATE) IN (SELECT day FROM recent)
),
g3 AS (
    SELECT round(quantile_cont(date_diff('millisecond', r.occurred_at, d.occurred_at) / 1000.0, 0.95), 1) AS p95_seconds
    FROM order_status_history d
    JOIN order_status_history r ON r.order_id = d.order_id AND r.sequence = 1
    WHERE d.sequence = 2 AND CAST(r.occurred_at AS DATE) IN (SELECT day FROM recent)
),
g3_tasks AS (
    SELECT round(100.0 * avg((decided_at <= due_at)::INTEGER), 1) AS on_time_pct
    FROM approval_tasks WHERE decided_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(created_at AS DATE) IN (SELECT day FROM recent)
),
g4 AS (
    SELECT round(sum(phone_stock_questions) / sum(working_days), 1) AS v
    FROM support_tally_weekly WHERE week_start IN (SELECT day FROM recent)
),
g5 AS (
    SELECT round(100.0 * avg((CAST(i.delivered_at AS DATE) = CAST(s.confirmed_at AS DATE))::INTEGER), 1) AS same_day_pct,
           round(median(date_diff('minute', s.confirmed_at, i.delivered_at)) / 60.0, 2)            AS median_hours
    FROM invoices i JOIN shipments s USING (order_id)
    WHERE i.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.confirmed_at AS DATE) IN (SELECT day FROM recent)
),
g6 AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS v FROM acknowledgements
    WHERE match_result = 'MISMATCH' AND strftime(acknowledged_at, '%Y-%m') = '2027-06'
)
SELECT 'G1' AS goal, 'Order lines received through the API or the portal' AS metric,
       '0%' AS baseline, 'at least 80% by October 2027' AS target,
       g1.v || '%' AS result,
       CASE WHEN g1.v >= 80 THEN 'Met' ELSE 'On the way; target date not reached' END AS status,
       CASE WHEN g1.v >= 80 THEN 'MET' ELSE 'ON_TRACK' END AS status_code,
       g1.v AS value_1, NULL::DOUBLE AS value_2
FROM g1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'G2', 'Orders corrected after entry', '4%', 'below 0.5%',
       g2.v || '% overall, ' || g2.v_integrated || '% for integrated orders',
       CASE WHEN g2.v < 0.5 THEN 'Met' WHEN g2.v_integrated < 0.5 THEN 'Met for integrated orders only' ELSE 'Not met' END,
       CASE WHEN g2.v < 0.5 THEN 'MET' WHEN g2.v_integrated < 0.5 THEN 'PARTLY_MET' ELSE 'NOT_MET' END,
       g2.v, g2.v_integrated
FROM g2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'G3', 'Time to first status; approvals within 4 business hours', 'about 1 working day',
       'under 2 minutes; approvals within 4 business hours',
       'p95 ' || g3.p95_seconds || ' s; ' || g3_tasks.on_time_pct || '% of approvals on time',
       CASE WHEN g3.p95_seconds < 120 AND g3_tasks.on_time_pct >= 100 THEN 'Met'
            WHEN g3.p95_seconds < 120 THEN 'Met for automatic decisions; approvals miss the 4-hour target'
            ELSE 'Not met' END,
       CASE WHEN g3.p95_seconds < 120 AND g3_tasks.on_time_pct >= 100 THEN 'MET'
            WHEN g3.p95_seconds < 120 THEN 'PARTLY_MET' ELSE 'NOT_MET' END,
       g3.p95_seconds, g3_tasks.on_time_pct
FROM g3, g3_tasks
UNION ALL
SELECT 'G4', 'Stock questions by phone per working day', 'about 60', 'below 6',
       g4.v || ' a day', CASE WHEN g4.v < 6 THEN 'Met' ELSE 'Not met' END,
       CASE WHEN g4.v < 6 THEN 'MET' ELSE 'NOT_MET' END, g4.v, NULL
FROM g4
UNION ALL
SELECT 'G5', 'Invoice in the dealer''s inbox on the day of shipment', '1.5 working days', 'same day',
       g5.same_day_pct || '% same day, median ' || g5.median_hours || ' hours',
       CASE WHEN g5.same_day_pct >= 95 THEN 'Met' ELSE 'Not met' END,
       CASE WHEN g5.same_day_pct >= 95 THEN 'MET' ELSE 'NOT_MET' END, g5.same_day_pct, g5.median_hours
FROM g5
UNION ALL
SELECT 'G6', 'Reconciliation mismatches in June 2027', 'about 45 a month', 'below 5 a month',
       g6.v || ' in June', CASE WHEN g6.v < 5 THEN 'Met' ELSE 'Not met' END,
       CASE WHEN g6.v < 5 THEN 'MET' ELSE 'NOT_MET' END, g6.v, NULL
FROM g6;
